events.body:
## Context

Every `public/*.html` page puts its nav in `<ul class="hidden md:flex ...">` with no toggle, so phones have no navigation at all. Decorative `<i class="fas">` icons lack `aria-hidden`.

## What to do

1. Add a hamburger `<button aria-expanded aria-controls>` and toggled list (pattern: `blt-enforcement/public/index.html`).
2. Add `aria-hidden="true"` to decorative icons.

> **Note:** Don't change the footer community links (under review in #39).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] At 375 px a menu button opens the nav on all 7 pages
- [ ] `aria-expanded` updates
- [ ] Icons hidden from screen readers

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-rewards && npx wrangler dev   # DevTools mobile viewport
```

---
